title: A 'last sent' line appears after a hand send
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with edit-customer permission (which governs sending), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders and use a row's Contact button to open the contact card. Seed a worklist row: enrol an asset (asset Maintenance tab -> Enrol) whose customer has contact details.
  3. One asset for which a reminder has already been sent by hand, and one for which none has.
custom_steps:
1. Open the card for an asset with no hand-send and confirm there is no last-sent line.
  2. Send a reminder, reopen the card and read the line beneath the address.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A line beneath the address reads "last sent <date>" once a reminder has been sent by hand for that asset, so nobody sends twice without knowing.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10571 (S14, Contact the customer from a row); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S14; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S14-R12: “A line beneath the address reads last sent <date> once a reminder has been sent by hand for that asset, so nobody sends twice without knowing”
